One base for player and enemy vitals; abilities pay costs and apply effects through it; the HUD reads CurrentStatsChanged
Shared by the player and enemies; default weapon equip happens in SetCharacterData (BUG-106)
Room clear, death and HUD binding are all event-driven
Room clear depends on ON_ENEMY_DEATH from pooled enemies
Damage formulas, vitals max values and asset serialization all read the stat system
Enemies attack through the same Weapon classes; AttackSO field renames break assets
Asset edits: missing script / orphaned key / saved-modifier checks
